head: BEAT THE
<g>NUMERICAL</g>
TEST STAGE.
hacks: Fast calculations save precious seconds on timed multi-choice questions.
Practise percentage change formulas on a real calculator today.
Misreading units or axes leads to easy errors under time pressure.
Check if table values are in thousands before doing any maths.
Every question usually carries equal weight in the final score.
Guess and flag tricky questions so you answer easy ones first.
Messy working leads to copying errors when under strict time limits.
Divide your paper into numbered boxes to keep work easy to recheck.
Getting used to clock pressure prevents panic during actual tests.
Complete one free timed test online before you start the real one.
out: Send it to a uni friend
